name: sync-forge
description: Local-first tool to build, run and verify data sync jobs between PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and Cosmos DB

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix engine && npm ci --prefix ui && git config core.hooksPath .githooks
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ui && npm run build --prefix engine
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix engine && npm run typecheck --prefix ui
